app.name: ARMSX2 Nightly
app.subtitle: The newest features, built most days. Installs beside the stable app.
app.localizedDescription:
The newest ARMSX2 features, built from the latest code most days. Less tested than a release, so expect the odd bug.

Most builds run fine. Now and then one carries a bug a release would have caught, or does not start. If you would rather play than test, install ARMSX2 iOS.

Nightly installs as its own app, next to the stable release rather than over it. Save states, memory cards and settings stay separate, so trying a nightly cannot disturb a working stable install. Nothing is shared between them either, so anything you save in one stays there.

Requirements
The same as the stable release: iPhone or iPad on iOS 17 or later, a JIT-capable setup, and your own PS2 BIOS and game files.

Links
Website: https://armsx2.net
Compatibility: https://armsx2.net/compatibility
Docs and FAQ: https://armsx2.net/docs
Discord: https://discord.gg/S7VxwfS8w9
Source code: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2

Support development
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/cw/ARMSX2
Ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/armsx2

Credits
ARMSX2 is open source under GPL-3.0 and builds on PCSX2. Started by MoonPower with support from jpolo1224, forked from PCSX2_ARM64 by Pontos.

App icon by fffathur, logo by Vivimagic. The icon artwork is MIT licensed: https://github.com/ARMSX2/Save-Tower

ARMSX2 does not include games or BIOS files. Donations are voluntary and the project seeks no commercial return. It is not officially associated with PCSX2 or with any other fork of it, and not affiliated with Sony Interactive Entertainment or PlayStation.

- Android: parenthesise the search-sections fallback
- tests: set the full-disk file size limit in process, not in a forked child
- GS: include <iterator> for std::back_inserter in the cache file store
- GS: clear the shader cache on the GS thread
- GS: cache files named by identity, so two builds keep one each
- GS: build identity from source files only, following adds and removes
- GS: cache store review fixes: locks, failed appends, in-place clears
- GS/Vulkan: record pipeline keys byte for byte
- GS: hash the cache identity's inputs from a plain glob
- Android: wipe the GS caches on every new install, and clear all of them
- Qt, FullscreenUI: Clear Shader Cache
- GS: Direct3D and frame-generation caches follow the build identity
- GS/OpenGL: program binaries on the checked store
- GS/Vulkan: pipeline key lists stamped with the build, checked per record
- GS/Vulkan: stamp and checksum the SPIR-V and pipeline caches
- GS: one checked on-disk format for the shader and pipeline caches
- GS/Vulkan: name the precompile workers within Linux's 15 characters
- GS/Vulkan: count precompile waits and log each worker's work
- GS/Vulkan: key lists per configuration, by session, with bounded memory
- gsrunner: pin precompile off before the command line, not after
- GS/Vulkan: precompile review fixes: failed jobs, cache dirtiness, indicator
- GS: pipeline precompile only under the hardware renderer
- gsrunner: pipeline precompile off unless asked for
- GS/Vulkan: build each game's recorded pipelines on worker threads at start
- GS/Vulkan: keep the SPIR-V cache across a driver change
- GS: count shader and pipeline compilation per stage, per frame
- tests: pin the DATE mode on a driver-ordered declared feedback loop
- GS: serve DATE in the pass on a driver-ordered declared feedback loop
- gsrunner: -no-stencil-buffer, to put the pre-26.2 Turnip DATE choices on one binary
- Android: end the search jump before the collapse test runs
- Android: settings search opens the target's section by name
- Android: end fast-forward hold when combo modifier is released
- Android: reveal collapsed settings search targets
